(()=>{ if(window.__lt.app.battleStartPanTimer) clearTimeout(window.__lt.app.battleStartPanTimer); window.__lt.launchBattle(1); if(window.__lt.app.battleStartPanTimer) clearTimeout(window.__lt.app.battleStartPanTimer); const b = window.__lt.getBattle(); const bear = b.allies.find(a=>a.id==='bear_guard'); if(bear){ bear.x = 0; bear.y = 8; } b.advanceEscortCart(); window.__lt.app.refreshBattleUI(); const cart = b.getEscortCart(); window.__lt.app.ui.frameTiles([cart, ...b.allies.filter(a=>a.hp>0), {x: 1, y: 5}], false, false); return { cartHp: cart ? cart.hp : 0, cartPos: cart ? {x:cart.x, y:cart.y} : null, step: b.escortStep, guarded: b.isCartGuarded() }; })()
